examples.en: We have just moved into a new house.
examples.zh: 我们刚搬进一栋新房子。

examples.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
examples.zh: 我一直在设法把新房间收拾整齐。

examples.en: I own over a thousand books.
I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
examples.zh: 我暂时把书放在了地板上。

examples.en: The books cover every inch of floor space.
They cover every inch of floor space.
examples.zh: 它们占据了每一寸地板空间。

examples.en: My sister helped me to carry an old bookcase up the stairs.
examples.zh: 我妹妹帮我把旧书柜搬上楼。

examples.en: She carried the bookcase up the stairs.
This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯。
她买了一条漂亮的地毯。

examples.en: She gazed at the books for some time.
examples.zh: 她凝视着那些书看了一会儿。

examples.en: You can read the carpet in your spare time.
examples.zh: 你可以在空闲时间读地毯。

To make matters worse, the room is rather small.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小。

examples.en: The books cover every inch of the floor.
examples.zh: 书覆盖了地板的每一寸。

sentences.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易，因为我拥有一千多本书。

sentences.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
sentences.zh: 我一直在设法把新房间收拾整齐。

sentences.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她走进我的房间，看到满地的书时大吃一惊。

sentences.en: She said that it was the prettiest carpet she had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 她说这是她见过的最漂亮的地毯。

sentences.en: She added that I did not need bookcases at all.
sentences.zh: 她补充说我根本不需要书柜。

article.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
article.zh: 我们刚搬进一栋新房子，我整个上午都在忙着干活。

article.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
article.zh: 我一直在设法把新房间收拾整齐。

article.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
article.zh: 这并不容易，因为我拥有一千多本书。

article.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
article.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小，所以我暂时把书都放在了地板上。

article.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space and I have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
article.zh: 现在它们占据了每一寸地板，我进出房间都不得不踩着书走。

article.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
article.zh: 不久前，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书柜搬上楼。

article.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
article.zh: 她走进我的房间，看到满地的书时大吃一惊。

article.en: She said that it was the prettiest carpet she had ever seen.
article.zh: 她说这是她见过的最漂亮的地毯。

article.en: She added that I did not need bookcases at all.
article.zh: 她补充说我根本不需要书柜。

article.en: She told me that I could sit here in my spare time and read the carpet!
article.zh: 她告诉我可以在空闲时间坐在这里读地毯！
